name: I-29 Speedway Long Course
description: Full long course of I-29 Speedway (formerly Raceway Park of the Midlands), Pacific Junction, Iowa. Cones close the short-course T1 hairpin; cutting through it counts as off-track. 36 paddock pit boxes. Based on zwiss's v0.9 scratch build; open source (Apache-2.0).
author: Vybes Forge
